0022600201.text: The Pelicans (4-5) visit the Clippers (1-7) on a one-game losing streak, with a 1-2 road record, sitting 11th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 3 games back. The Clippers have lost seven straight, are 13th in the West, and have had four of their injured players ruled out: Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, and the Pelicans won the most recent meeting 105-99 in New Orleans on March 19, 2026.
